d: Various talented participants from India compete against each other during a singing competition in order to impress the judges and win the title.
The Pandavas confidently announce that Arjun will emerge victorious in the challenge against Duryodhan. However, Duryodhan seeks to prove them wrong and turn the tide in his favour.
Jethalal gets scared when Bawri brings a bottle of wine to his house. When Champaklal sees it, Jethalal tells him that it is a bottle of imported perfume.
Daya and her friends make the decision to put together a cocktail party; Jethalal scolds Bawree and tells her that she should have passed the parcel on to Bagha.
Jethalal and Sodhi meet to go to Popatlal's house for the party. They eventually arrive and join their friends for food, drinks and a good time.
During the party, the men of Gokuldham drink an alcoholic beverage from France. However, they discover, to their horror, that it is poisonous.
The Gokuldham men have their own gathering at Popatlal's home. Later, Popatlal receives a call from a friend, who suggests he watch the news.
When the men realize the alcohol they drank is poisonous, they start to panic. So, Dr. Hathi quickly calls for ambulances to be sent to Gokuldham society.
Champaklal asks for the perfume from France, which makes Jethalal nervous; Mr Sinha comes to Jethalal's residence with a gift for him.
Bagha excitedly informs Jethalal that a major hotel chain wants to order televisions from them in bulk. Jethalal goes to the shop to confirm the order.
Everyone in Gokuldham society happily celebrates Diwali. They all have fun at the festival of lights. Jethalal tries to take his father's blessings, but guests keep coming.
Nattu Kaka and Bagha play a prank on Jethalal by welcoming him to the shop in a grand manner. Jethalal later becomes delighted when customers keep coming to his shop.
After Diwali ends, society members are back to normal lifestyle. Jethalal is lazy to wake up, while Taarak tries to avoid the bitter gourd juice made by Anjali.
After finding himself in trouble early in the morning, Bhide also has a problem with the auto-rickshaw driver and loses his house keys. It is a bad day for Bhide.
While Madhvi helps Bhide to search for the house keys, several people come to give bills. Bhide later tries to start Sakharam, but it does not work.
After returning home, Bhide finds his house is in a mess. He also learns that the jewellery and Madhvi are missing. He becomes anxious, and everyone comes to help him.
After receiving a call, Chalu Pandey arrives at Gokuldham society. He starts to investigate to solve the case and listens to Bhide's explanation, but Jethalal later comes and creates confusion.
Chalu Pandey asks questions to everyone involved and people who visited society during the relevant time. Suddenly, a suspicious blue car drives into Gokuldham society.

After witnessing Balveer beat Hatuba in a fight, the Evil Gorilla turns over a new leaf and apologises for his crimes. Later, he releases King Gorilla and frees all the other imprisoned gorillas.
When Bhayankar Pari asks Nokili and Katili Pari to get Baalveer's wand from Parilok.
Nokili Pari successfully steals Baalveer's wand and uses it to obtain the powers of fairies. Meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari sends Katili Pari to coach the players competing against Baalveer's team.
Bhayankar asks Katili Pari to make sure that the players competing against Baalveer's team win.
When the fairies gradually lose their abilities, they realise something is wrong and speculate that Baalveer's weapon may have been taken. Later, Rani Pari utilises magic to find the offender.
Bhayankar Pari tells Nokili Pari and Katili Pari to steal Baalveer's wand and ensure that Baalveer's opponent team wins. Later, Katili Pari joins the opponent team as a coach.
Jethalal gets mad at Daya after her new shampoo ruins his hair. Meanwhile, Daya tries to find a solution to the problem.
Taarak Mehta decides to have some fun and tells Jethalal that his only option to get out of the problem is to go bald.
Goli and Gogi head to Taarak's house to check on him. Meanwhile, the women of Gokuldham Society go to the temple.
Taarak and Tapu Sena enjoy an extravagant feast. However, Taarak worries that Anjali will discover his lie.
Taarak takes a day off from work after Anjali calls his boss. Later, a dietician arrives at the Mehtas' house to check on Taarak.
The residents of Gokuldham Society panic when Taarak begins acting strangely. Soon, Dr Hathi calls a psychiatrist for help.
The residents hold a meeting to discuss Taarak's condition. Soon, Babita comes up with an unexpected idea.
Champaklal suggests a couple of remedies to cure Taarak Mehta of his condition. However, the residents of Gokuldham are taken aback by his suggestions.
The residents of Gokuldham organise a ritual to cure Taarak Mehta of his condition. However, strange things soon start to take place during the rituals.
Choodi Wale Baba performs a special ritual to remove the ghost in Taarak's body. Meanwhile, Tapu and Taarak try to find a solution to their problems.
The monk casts a spell on a member of Gokuldham society which makes her start dancing. Meanwhile, an anxious Taarak Mehta watches on from a distance.
Taarak Mehta finds himself in trouble as the priest performs an absurd ritual around him. Later, the priest takes some chilli powder and is about to smear it on Taarak Mehta.
On learning that Taarak Mehta has scammed her, Anjali threatens to walk away, but he stops her. Later, Anjali announces that she is parting ways with Taarak Mehta.
On learning that Taarak Mehta was play-acting, Tapu and his friends blame Jethalal for helping Taarak Mehta. Later, Jethalal struggles to justify his actions.
Salman Khan and Anushka Sharma join the programme to promote their film 'Sultan'. Meanwhile, the team performs hilarious sketches and engages the guests in witty banter.
Kapil Sharma invites Ajay Devgn, Nora Fatehi, Ammy Virk and Sharad Kelkar to discuss their movie and entertain the audience with hilarious interactions.
After getting vaccinated, Jethalal begins to feel pain in his arm. However, Champaklal refuses to take Jethalal's pain seriously.
Jethalal panics when he learns that a mouse has entered his godown overnight. Soon, he tries to find a solution to the problem.
The residents of a housing society help each other find solutions when they face common real-life challenges and get involved in sticky situations.
While Bhide and Iyer discuss the festival budget, Tapu and his friends have their own tricks up their sleeves.
Bhide is determined to beat Tapu Sena and organise the festival. Later, everyone waits for Jethalal to begin the meeting.
Tapu Sena and Bhide continue to fight about who should organise the festival. Soon, Champaklal comes up with a solution to their problem.
Bhide has a strange and magical dream involving Lord Ganesha. Soon, he prepares for Lord Ganesha's arrival.
Bhide is conflicted about whether to bring Lord Ganesha home. However, Jethalal remains adamant about bringing the idol to Gokuldham.
Jethalal and Bhide seek a few pandits' help to resolve their issues. However, the pandits' solutions only add to their problems.
After giving it a lot of thought, the residents of Gokuldham set out to welcome Lord Ganesha. However, they encounter numerous obstacles along the way.
Jethalal is annoyed when his uncle suddenly drops in for a visit. Soon, he tries to get rid of his uncle at the earliest.
Jethalal is left in a lurch as his relative moves in with him unannounced and to make things worse, Jethalal is forced to pay for his relative's commute to Mumbai.
The residents begin their Ganesh Chaturthi festivities. Later, they dress up as various famous historical figures for a skit.
